scope: Club Arena MultiTable authoritative seat rebuilding
behavior: Successful empty seat truth reconciles seated tabs and completes readiness without a table metadata query.
Spectator, pending buy-in, lobby and hub tabs survive; current live seats can use slots released by stale seats.
Failed, rejected, null or malformed seat reads and failed metadata reads do not prune tabs.
Opaque auth scope, rendered identity, request and membership revisions suppress stale completions, including auth events before user-store renders and A-to-B-to-A sessions.
New seat admissions, including already seated tabs, invalidate old reads before React batching and schedule a fresh snapshot.
New live card contents or turn activation during a pending snapshot trigger a fresh read; equal card strings and pot/deadline updates do not starve cleanup.
A voluntary-leave fence prevents reopening a pending-cashout seat until absence or genuine new admission is observed.
Deferred focus callbacks require current request identity; closure notices reflect committed state and run once under StrictMode.

original_regression.selected_test: closes the final stale seated tab after successful zero-seat truth
original_regression.actual_failure: Original page retains rendered Felt A after an authoritative empty seat response.
original_regression.method: Exact HEAD page copied to a temporary alternate import; same real-page test runs against it. Both temporary files removed in finally.
original_regression.other_cases: 21 unselected by targeted baseline filter; no candidate tests skipped.

validation.artifact: Local DIRTY build, behind origin/main by 8 at verification; not a release artifact.
validation.limits: Actual MultiTablePage, React DOM, routing and bus subscription hook execute with controlled transport and child felt responses. No live database or engine mutation is performed.

independent_review.verdict: Final handler/read-race blockers resolved; bounded candidate accepted after current-source verification.
independent_review.integrator: Root owns fresh-main integration, normal CI, publication and adoption checks.

release_limits: No satellite RPC or accounting backend dependency.
A future publication does not prove already-open legacy tabs adopted the fix.
No Phase 3 programme control is newly closed by this isolated client proof.
